stem: Business Care, Voltmarkt's device-support subscription for small offices, had €19,600 of MRR in March 2026. In April, 10 businesses paying €40 a month cancelled, 8 businesses moved from the €40 plan to the €65 plan, and 20 new businesses joined at €40 a month. What is the MRR for April? Give it in thousands of euros with 1 decimal, for example 12.5 for €12,500.
